evals.prompt: Do we have any skipped or disabled tests in evals/files/sample-repo, and why were they skipped?
evals.expected_output: Runs test_inventory.py and ../audit-code-scan/scripts/grep_scan.py. Lists exactly one skipped test: OrderServiceTests.CancelAsync_rejects_orders_that_are_already_paid (xUnit [Fact(Skip=...)], tests/Shop.Api.Tests/OrderServiceTests.cs:20) with reason 'Flaky since the SQL Server 2022 upgrade - see issue #412'. Explains that the skipped test is the only guard on the cancel-paid-order rule (data mutation / money state transition) and that the same issue #412 is cited for disabling the CI test step, so the skip and the CI change share a root cause. Recommends fixing the flakiness or converting to a deterministic unit test and re-enabling it, tracking skips with an expiry.
expectations: Reports exactly one skipped test and names CancelAsync_rejects_orders_that_are_already_paid
Gives the reason string from the Skip attribute
Connects the skip to the commented-out CI test step via issue #412 or the SQL Server 2022 upgrade
Does not invent other skipped tests in AuthControllerTests.cs

evals.prompt: Can you check if our CI in evals/files/sample-repo has the gates it should have - tests, analyzers, security scanning, branch protection?
evals.expected_output: Runs ci_scan.py. CI gate checklist: GitHub Actions ci.yml triggers on push and pull_request to main; steps are checkout, setup-dotnet, restore, build, publish, upload-artifact; test gate missing (commented out at lines 21-23); lint/analyzer missing (no -warnaserror / dotnet format); security scan missing (no dotnet list package --vulnerable, CodeQL, gitleaks); coverage missing; reproducible install missing (dotnet restore without --locked-mode); artifact version missing (artifact name shop-api, no version); signing missing; actions pinned to tags not SHAs (Low); branch protection unknown - CODEOWNERS exists but is not enforcement, verify with gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/main/protection. Deploy gate n/a (no deploy job). Findings for the missing test gate (High) and missing security scan (Medium) at minimum.
expectations: States that the pipeline runs on pull requests but has no active test step and cites the commented-out dotnet test lines
Marks analyzers and security scanning as missing
Marks branch protection as unknown and gives the gh api (or equivalent) command to verify it
Notes CODEOWNERS is present but is not by itself a merge gate
Mentions dotnet restore without --locked-mode as a reproducibility gap
